showroom.resolution: AutoTrader is the dealer-maintained, currently active profile with map coordinates. Photography corroborates a recent move: every car listed on lussoauto.co.za up to July 2026 (e.g. SF90 Stradale, 296 GTS, GTC4Lusso, California 30) was photographed in a concrete-pillared space with city windows — matching the CBD description — while every car listed in September 2026 (Dino 308 GT4, 550 Maranello, Macan, SVR, 320d, and all AutoTrader-only stock) is photographed in a black steel-clad hall. The contact page still saying 'CBD' was last edited 15 June 2026, before the move. No street address is published anywhere, so none is shown. MUST be confirmed by the client before launch.
